reviewer: OpenAI assistant; not an independent human reviewer
scope: Identity of the coral scorer around candidate score posts; not a full independently counted match or scoring-level benchmark

protocol.prediction_visibility: Predicted team credit and track boxes hidden while assigning labels. Candidate timestamps came from system events; candidate categories were encountered during setup but not used as visual proof.
protocol.coverage: Full broadcast sampled every 2 seconds from video time 8 to 166 seconds. All 25 candidate coral actions examined in both reef close-ups at post minus 2.5, minus 1.0, and plus 0.8 seconds. Additional 1-second sequences reviewed at red 90-96 and blue 97-101, 105-109, 115-123, 127-133, 139-148, 151-164 seconds.
protocol.identity_basis: Visible bumper numbers and distinctive mechanisms tracked through the unannotated broadcast; no pipeline identity labels used.
protocol.primary_set: accepted labels only; provisional and uncertain excluded and reported separately
protocol.limitations: AI-reviewed labels require independent human confirmation. Candidate sampling cannot measure missed scoring actions. Close-ups contain occlusions and late camera cuts. Video sampling is not continuous real-time playback. No parameter tuning on these labels before initial evaluation.
